description: Copies what you point at in a BB Browser tab: pick any element and get a structured markdown block — page URL, viewport, CSS selector, ARIA role and name, bounds, link, and text — or a PNG of just that element, or a screenshot of the visible tab. One icon button in the thread header opens the three modes, the picker outlines each target with a hover highlight and label as you move, and password and credential fields never contribute text or values.
